# `omapac-repo tool-channel publish`

- **Usage:** `omapac-repo tool-channel publish <FLAGS>`

Vet a release and publish it to edge

## Flags
- **`-c --config <CONFIG>`** — The tool.toml describing the vendor and artifacts
- **`--version <VERSION>`** — Publish this release instead of the newest eligible one
- **`--allow-downgrade`** — Accept a lower evidence level or another key than last time
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
